name: Nuer
gender_roles: men herd cattle, women cultivate and milk
notes: Classic segmentary lineage society documented by Evans-Pritchard (1940)

name: Trobriand Islanders
gender_roles: men clear gardens, women tend them; both fish
notes: Documented by Malinowski; Kula ring exchange; yam houses as wealth display

name: Maasai
property_inheritance: cattle and livestock through male line
gender_roles: warriors (moran) defend herds; women build houses and milk
age_grades: elaborate age-set system central to social organization
notes: Age-set system structures male life stages; cattle are central to economy and ritual

name: Iroquois Confederacy
property_inheritance: property through female line; longhouse inheritance
gender_roles: women control agriculture and longhouses; men hunt and wage war
notes: Great Law of Peace; clan mothers hold political power; longhouse social organization

name: !Kung San
gender_roles: flexible division; both gather, men primarily hunt
notes: Classic foraging society; hxaro exchange network; studied by Richard Lee
